text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Jan 3rd, 2019 // No Comments
Equities Research Analysts’ price target changes for Thursday, January 3rd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price reduced by DA Davidson to $260.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Blackbaud (NASDAQ:BLKB) had its target price trimmed by DA Davidson to $65.00. DA Davidson currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
CIGNA (NYSE:CI) had its target price cut by Wells Fargo & Co from $221.00 to $200.00. They currently have a market perform rating on the stock.
FormFactor (NASDAQ:FORM) had its target price reduced by Sidoti from $18.00 to $16.00. Sidoti currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Lundin Mining (TSE:LUN) was given a C$8.70 price target by analysts at Morgan Stanley. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
NorthWest Health Prop Real Est Inv Trust (TSE:NWH.UN) had its target price lowered by National Bank Financial from C$11.50 to C$10.00. The firm currently has a sector perform rating on the stock.
Prosiebensat 1 Media (ETR:PSM) was given a €30.00 ($34.88) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Stingray Group (TSE:RAY.A) had its target price cut by National Bank Financial from C$11.00 to C$9.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
SVB Financial Group (NASDAQ:SIVB) had its price target lowered by Piper Jaffray Companies to $285.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Systemax (NYSE:SYX) had its target price reduced by Sidoti from $42.00 to $34.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
